text: Neurology is a branch of clinical medicine that studies the etiology, pathology, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases of the nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves and skeletal muscles. Its core objective is to address functional disorders caused by organic or functional lesions of the nervous system (such as paralysis, epilepsy, cognitive impairment, etc.) through the integration of neuroscience theory and clinical practice. This discipline is both complex and cutting-edge - the nervous system serves as the "command center" of the human body, with a wide variety of disease types (over a thousand), and often involves the intersection of multiple systems (such as neuro-immune, neuro-vascular associations). Therefore, it is necessary to integrate multi-dimensional knowledge such as neuroanatomy, electrophysiology, imaging technology, and molecular biology It is one of the disciplines in clinical medicine where theory and practice are highly integrated.
